stage_rules: The four dimensions are independent, not one monotonic status ladder.
A Request for Service or contract does not prove ground-breaking, grid connection, power delivery or commercial operation.
A construction-complete status can coexist with pre-commercial operation and unknown connection.
An issuer active-power label is preserved without equating it to measured IT load or independent operation verification.
Source authority is not a stage. Official hosting, financial audit status or dataset inclusion does not establish independent physical validation.
An event repeated in a later filing does not acquire the filing period as a new physical observation date.

edge_class_definitions.factual_match: Directly evidenced source identity, pairing, repetition or containment; remains at the source authority level.
edge_class_definitions.possible_match: A candidate bridge lacks essential identity or scope evidence; do not merge or allocate.
edge_class_definitions.rejected_join: The proposed use is unsupported or conflicts with source scope/definitions; reason and missing evidence retained.

aggregation_policy: This investigation authorizes no capacity summation or conversion.
For a later separately authorized aggregator, explicit disjoint asset scopes, common metric definition, compatible date and stage, and supported containment would be prerequisites.
Do not add parents to included phases/children, alternate capacity ratings of the same asset, repeated disclosures, or successive stocks/vintages.
A reporting split does not itself establish physical subdivision, added demand or conserved numerical partition.
Lower-bound and approximate values are not point estimates; do not derive exact differences or growth from them.
Do not convert MW into GPUs/FLOPs, generation into delivered load, unknown AI allocation into a share, or any resource quantity into catastrophe probability.
missing_record_rules: An HTTP error, login wall, disabled retrieval or missing text is acquisition failure, never asset absence.
A successful later table that omits an entity can only support absent-from-that-artifact, subject to table scope and complete relevant inspection.
Commissioning, cancellation, retirement and resolution each require affirmative dated evidence; elapsed targets are forecasts only.
Retain older assertions and link corrections; do not replace history silently.
minimum_epoch_join: Both artifact identifiers, versions and exact source locators.
Issuer/company identifier and time-specific role: asset owner, facility operator, tenant, primary user or developer.
Public site identity: stable project/permit/parcel identifier or an explicit alias bridge corroborated by precise location.
Parent campus and building/hall/phase/leased-portion identity with a clear physical boundary.
An individually inspected Epoch record identifier/permalink and its applicable vintage.
Dates to establish temporal overlap and distinguish planned from observed states.
Compatible metric boundary, unit, qualifier and stage; monetary ownership share is not capacity allocation.
An explicit source-backed containment or allocation edge before assigning operator quantities to a phase.
minimum_queue_to_generator_join: Queue authority namespace plus original source request identifier, with request vintage.
Explicit parent/replacement/split and hybrid-component relationships where source documents supply them; preserve one-to-many mappings.
Exact EIA Plant ID plus exact Generator ID, with vintage; preserve ID string punctuation and do not merge by generator name alone.
An authoritative bridge document that identifies both sides and which units, phases, or components the request covers.
Request, study, agreement, construction, connection and commercial-operation dates/statuses distinguished; request date and target date cannot be COD.
Capacity definition and unit on each side; aggregate request MW cannot be silently apportioned to a generator.
Provenance, source locator, publication/revision dates and redistribution terms for each link.
No claim that LBNL exposes these named columns: the linked codebook was not inspected.
canonical_mapping: Partial structural mapping only. Native asset, relationship and independent stage-axis support is absent; no new schema implemented.
